Allergic skin reactions, diarrhea, headache, hypertension, insomnia, itching, increased libido, nervousness, palpitations, and vaginal bleeding are potential adverse effects of American ginseng. 72. American ginseng may exacerbate conditions such as hypertension during pregnancy, breast cancer, endometrial cancer, endometriosis, hemorrhage, hormone-sensitive conditions, ovarian cancer, thrombosis, and uterine fibroids. 73. Avoid using American ginseng prior to surgery, as it may increase the risk of bleeding. 74. Caution is advised in individuals with bleeding disorders, cardiac disorders, diabetes mellitus, hypotension, insomnia, or schizophrenia. 75. Pregnancy Category: Not applicable. 76.
